title: Sepiabox search DSL v1
description: What the filter bar, POST /api/search and the question translator send to the search (D-020, S-013, D-069). Every filter given must match (AND); the values of one list match when any does (OR). Unknown fields are rejected.

dateFrom.description: First day included, on the camera's wall clock.

dateTo.description: Last day included; not before dateFrom.

onThisDay.description: Today's day and month (in the configured time zone): yearsAgo years ago, or in every earlier year when yearsAgo is absent.

cities.description: GeoNames city names as the catalog stores them ("Lisbon"), matched ignoring case and accents.

savedPlaces.description: The family's own places (S-014), by the names they gave them, matched ignoring case: items taken inside any of them (within its radius). An unknown name is an error.

distanceFrom.description: How far from the centre of one of the family's places (place, by name) or from home (home: true) the item was taken (S-014): more than minKm and at most maxKm. Exactly one of place and home; at least one of minKm and maxKm. Items without a location never match.

sources.description: Source names, such as the drive's name given to process, matched ignoring case.

sourceCount.description: How many different sources the item was found in (S-028, D-093): eq is exactly that many (1 is "in only one source"), gte at least that many (2 is "in several"). Exactly one of eq and gte. The same source name twice counts once. Source names are compared exactly as stored, case-sensitively, unlike sources, which ignores case. Never part of the question translator's output format.

people.description: People who are all in the photo (S-021): every name in all (people's names as the family wrote them, matched ignoring case; an unknown name is an error) and, with includeMe, the signed-in user's own person ("This is me"). At least one of the two.

eventIds.description: Assets in any of these occasions (S-023, D-092), by id; an id no occasion has matches nothing, and undated assets are in no occasion. Never part of the question translator's output format: a question cannot name an occasion.

eventTypes.description: Assets in an occasion of any of these types (S-024, D-094). wedding, birthday, beach, christmas, graduation, snow and party are told by the photos' CLIP embeddings; trip is an occasion of a day or more more than 100 km from the place marked as home. Assets in no occasion, or in one without a type, never match.

visual.description: A description in English matched against the photos' CLIP embeddings (S-016, D-070); results are ordered by similarity, most similar first, and sort is not used.

minScore.description: The least cosine similarity between the text and a photo; 0.2 when absent.

similarTo.description: The assets most similar to one asset by their stored CLIP embeddings (S-017, D-086), the asset itself left out; combined with the other filters, ordered by similarity, most similar first, and sort is not used. Not together with visual or aggregate. Never part of the question translator's output format: a question cannot name an asset.

assetId.description: The asset's id: the SHA-256 of its content in lower-case hex.

limit.description: The most similar assets returned; 50 when absent, and never more than the query's limit.

undatedOnly.description: Only assets without a capture date; not together with dateFrom, dateTo, years, months or onThisDay.

sort.description: Undated assets come last either way.

aggregate.description: Count the matching assets instead of listing them (S-026, D-075), or the occasions they are in (count events, S-024); sort and limit do not apply. Without groupBy, the total only.

count.description: assets: photos and videos; events: the occasions with at least one matching asset, each once.

groupBy.description: Absent or null for the total only. year and month are the capture year and the month of the year (1-12) on the camera's wall clock; an asset with several sources counts in each source; person is each named person in the photos, once per photo, without the people the filters name; eventType (only with count events) is the occasions' types, those without one together.

sum.description: Also add up the sizes of the matching items (S-028, D-093): bytes is the size of the originals. Not together with groupBy person. Never part of the question translator's output format.

top.description: Only with groupBy: the largest this many groups. Absent: every year, month or kind group in its own order, or the largest 10 cities, sources or people.
